dedupe_keys.name: s2 conus hand labeled flood data

description: This Zenodo dataset publishes 146 manually labelled Sentinel-2 flood-image tiles for the continental United States. Its metadata describes tiles of about 400 by 400 pixels representing 4 km squares, with optical RGB, near-infrared and short-wave-infrared bands. Ancillary rasters include elevation, water bodies, roads, flowlines, land cover and scene classification. A modeller could use the labelled water pixels to train or assess a flood-observation model, then feed mapped inundation into an infrastructure exposure simulation. The Zenodo record gives a DOI, CC BY 4.0 licence and one compressed archive of about 2.75 GB. The record links to the separate floodmaps code repository, whose preparation pipeline has its own draft. This review checked only the record metadata and archive listing; it did not download tiles, examine annotation boundaries, test georegistration or reproduce the 64 by 64 patching described by the authors. Coverage across flood events and regions is not quantified in the metadata inspected. Related resources include the Sentinel source scenes and the distinct GitHub software pipeline.
name: S2 CONUS Hand Labeled Flood Data
notes: G8; G8-0822. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.

sources.note: Resource identity and access checked on its own provider page, following a GitHub curated-list link.
